text:
neal: Heads up - saw a batch of tenants where invoice-preview showed ~2x tokens for a ~5m window. final invoices deduped and looked fine. suspect routing rollovers (weight shift) caused same request to be served by old+new route and both paths emitted usage event. example tenant t-cascade.

tara: Oof. do we have sample events? could be missing idempotency key on the route switch.

neal: sample (sanitized):
```
{
  "tenant": "t-cascade",
  "req_id": "r-9a2",
  "route": "v1-primary",
  "tokens": 300,
  "emitted_at": "2026-03-22T18:04:12Z",
  "dedupe_key": null
}
{
  "tenant": "t-cascade",
  "req_id": "r-9a2",
  "route": "v2-canary",
  "tokens": 300,
  "emitted_at": "2026-03-22T18:04:12Z",
  "dedupe_key": null
}
```

raj: That matches the routing weight-shift we did at 18:03. We relied on consumer-side dedupe later in pipeline, but preview indexer currently counts raw events from the stream before dedupe. finalizer dedupes later so invoice is correct. previews are noisy.

billing-ops: Support is getting tickets - customers panicked seeing doubled previews. We need a short-term mitigation that reduces customer confusion.

console-ui: UX idea: show a small inline note in preview: "duplicates detected: X" and a tooltip explaining previews are computed from raw events and may include duplicates during route rollouts. Also offer a toggle `ui.preview_hide_duplicates` so CS can hide duplicates per-tenant until we fix.

neal: Instrumentation asks: add `metering.duplicate_rate` (per-tenant, per-route), `routing.rollover_inflight` gauge, and `finalizer.dedupe_latency_ms` histogram. Also temp alert: duplicate_rate > 1% for > 10m -> page.

raj: Implementation plan: 1) fast fix - preview indexer should apply the same dedupe key logic as finalizer (use `req_id` or `trace_id`) before counting. patch should be small (indexer join on req_id) and canary 0.5% region. 2) longer - route layer should stamp `dedupe_key` at ingress so both paths emit same key. 3) console FF + badge.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy: preview-indexer-dedupe -> eu-west1 canary at 18:30 UTC. auto-rollback if `metering.duplicate_rate` does not drop within 5m.

tara: Quick note: be careful with memory in the indexer when deduping (we may need bounded LRU based on time window). prefer a tumbling window dedupe (30s) rather than unbounded map.

raj: Good call. we'll implement a sliding-window bloom filter + fallback exact-map for high-value tenants. will add metric `dedupe.filter_fpr` to monitor false positives.

billing-ops: Also request a nightly reconciliation report that lists tenants with preview-invoice delta > 0.5% and the top routes contributing. CS wants this as a CSV to triage cases.

neal: Action items: raj - PR for preview-indexer dedupe + route stamping RFC; tara - memory safety review + LRU param suggestions; console-ui - FF + badge mock + copy; billing-ops - desired CSV schema for nightly report. sync at 18:25 to validate canary playbook.

raj: I'll include a short smoke test that emits paired events (two routes same req_id) and assert preview count == deduped count.

tara: ack. I'll also add an alert for indexer memory > 70% after deploy.

neal: Thanks. let's keep rollouts conservative until we see dedupe metrics stabilize. :thumbsup:
